title: ordering soup at a cafe

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: What comes with the bean soup?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: A. A slice of bread. B. I ordered the soup. C. It needs more salt.
turns.zh: A. 一片麵包。 B. 我點了豆湯。 C. 還需要加一點鹽。
